module: Flowgraph node "Menu Closed" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). One-frame impulse on the menuClosed output when a menu has been closed and the player is back in game (onUIPlayStateChanged hook with enteredPlay true).
notes: Its in-game description is "Util Helper for Garage tutorial" (copy-paste).

work.desc: Every frame: menuClosed to false, applies then clears the flags.

onUIPlayStateChanged.desc: Hook: if the player has returned to the play state, raises the menuClosed flag.

enteredPlay.desc: true if entering the play state
